description: The five files in scope are the remaining git-heavy review, decomposition, and approval-fingerprint unit test files: tests/flow/review/test_sync_points.py, tests/flow/review/test_ledger_commit.py, tests/flow/review/test_loop.py, tests/flow/stages/test_decomposition.py, and tests/test_approval_fingerprint.py. Per-test coverage shows test_decomposition.py's in-flow cases overlap heavily (several cases whose lines are a subset of test_child_that_itself_decomposes_in_the_same_second_gets_its_own_branches_and_lists_its_children).
goal: Cut git subprocess spawns across the five files in scope by at least 30 percent with measurable wall-clock time reduction without weakening what they prove: share pipeline scenarios that several tests only read, reach a stage's start state from a template repository instead of running earlier stages, build property-test histories in test_approval_fingerprint.py with batched git plumbing (for example git fast-import) while preserving defect-finding, and collapse identical-coverage cases only where the parameter is data the code does not branch on. Test code only: never modify files under apps/sandbox-executor/src or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, and keep every touched module within its line budget. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Reducing repeated git subprocess spawns across these five git-heavy test files measurably cuts unit test runtime on both macOS and ubuntu CI runners and workspace survival runs with zero production code risk.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes carry a before and after table per file in scope (flow/review/test_sync_points.py, flow/review/test_ledger_commit.py, flow/review/test_loop.py, flow/stages/test_decomposition.py, and test_approval_fingerprint.py) showing summed test time, case count, and git process count from 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress" --durations=0 --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine, median of at least three alternating runs; git subprocess spawns across the files in scope fall by at least 30 percent with measurable wall-clock time reduction.

Every removed or merged test is listed with the surviving test that proves the same behaviour and the evidence (identical or subset line coverage from a per-test coverage context run, plus the assertion it carried now made by the surviving test). No test that guards a distinct behaviour is removed: a test named for a regression, an incident or an edge case is kept or its assertion is folded into a surviving test, never dropped, and property tests in test_approval_fingerprint.py preserve their defect-finding coverage.
Line and branch coverage do not fall, and the mutation score of touched modules does not fall.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed.
The module budget file is not changed, and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"', the files in scope also pass serially with '-p no:xdist' (no order dependence from shared fixtures), and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
